comparison.objective: Install a rack-server air shroud by engaging two tabs beneath a fan cage and seating the shroud.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual transport, tilt-sensitive dual-tab insertion, and constrained lowering around server components.
comparison.success_condition: Both tabs are inserted at least 3 mm, all four corners are seated within 2 mm, and the shroud is released and still.
comparison.reason: Dual-tab insertion and seating test assembly alignment, whereas the candidate tests selective particle passage and retention during controlled agitation. No material rubric details are missing.
